CM Appl. 62640/2025[Exemption from filing certified/typed copies]
2. Allowed, subject to the Appellant filing certified/typed copies of the annexures within a period of three weeks.
3. The Application stands disposed of.

MAC.APP. 648/2025 & CM Appl. 62639/2025[Stay]
4. The present Appeal has been filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 impugning the award dated 20.05.2025 passed by the learned Presiding Officer, MACT (NW), Rohini Courts,
Delhi [hereinafter referred to as "Impugned Award"].
By the Impugned Award, the compensation amount in the sum of Rs. 41,48,300/- along with interest at the rate of 9% per annum has been awarded.
5. Learned Counsel for the Appellant submits that the Impugned Award This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/10/2025 at 21:42:08 wrongly found the father of the deceased as dependent even though the father was an agriculturist and earning some amounts from his land.

In addition, it is contended that by order dated The Oriental Insurance Co Ltd vs Umesh (Deceased) Through Its Lrs & Ors on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51953704/
1 06.02.2023, the learned Tribunal had directed that interest from 06.02.2023 to the date of passing of the Impugned Award would be stopped which was not done in the final Award.

sentences.text: 6. Issue Notice.
On steps being taken, let Notice be issued to the Respondents via all modes.
An affidavit of service be filed within two weeks.
7. Subject to the deposit of entire decretal amount inclusive of up-to-date interest within a period of 8 weeks, the operation of the Impugned Award shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
In the event, there is any default in depositing the amount, the interim protection granted by this Court shall automatically stand vacated.

7.1 Upon deposit by the Appellant, 70% of the deposited amount inclusive of up-to-date interest shall be released to the Respondents/claimants in accordance with scheme, as is set out in the Impugned Award.
8. The Registry is directed to place on record the digital copy of the Trial Court Record duly paginated and book-marked in accordance with the rules of the High Court.

9. List before the concerned Registrar for completion of service on 04.12.2025.
10.
The parties will act based on the digitally signed copy of the order.
TARA VITASTA GANJU, J OCTOBER 6, 2025/r
